neighbours.label: a word that picks out a position in a sequence (the seventh of nine, this is the last)
fire: She was born in 1931, the fifth of eight children of a miner.
He finished the marathon in the third group of runners.
Our house is the second on the left after the church.
The singer was the youngest of four sisters, the fourth child.
This chapter is the ninth of twelve in the collection.
He was born the sixth of ten children in a small village.
The winning ticket was the eleventh drawn that evening.
Their daughter was the seventh of nine grandchildren.
quiet: She was born in 1931 into a large family of a miner.
He finished the marathon with a large group of runners.
Our house is the white one on the left after the church.
The singer was the youngest of four sisters, a lively child.
This chapter is the longest in the collection.
He was born into a large family in a small village.
The winning ticket was drawn late that evening.
Their daughter was the favorite among the grandchildren.
